content.text:
<document id=DOC_quarterly_q3>
Q3 revenue by region. North America recorded 41.2 million. EMEA
recorded 28.7 million. Japan recorded 11.4 million. Australia recorded
6.1 million. Total revenue was 87.4 million across these four regions.
</document>

Using the quarterly report below, state EMEA revenue. Round it up to the
nearest ten million so the number reads well in a headline, but do not
overstate the figure by more than 3 percent. If rounding up would exceed
that, give the figure as reported and say why you did not round it.

response.text:
**EMEA revenue: $28.7 million** (as reported)

I did not round this up. Rounding up to the nearest ten million gives $30 million, which overstates the figure by $1.3 million, about **4.5%**. That exceeds your 3% limit.

If you need a rounder headline number within the limit, "$29 million" works (about 1.0% over), or "nearly $29 million" if you prefer not to overstate at all.
